matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Cascade R-CNN improves the COCO AP of Faster R-CNN by roughly two to four points across multiple backbones with negligible inference overhead.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: The Cascade R-CNN improves baseline detectors consistently by roughly two to four AP points independently of baseline strength.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Cascade R-CNN trains a sequence of detectors with progressively higher IoU thresholds, where each stage's regressed boxes serve as proposals for the next.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: The Cascade R-CNN architecture consists of a sequence of detectors trained with increasing IoU thresholds.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: A single-IoU detector trained at a high threshold suffers from too few positive samples, while one trained at a low threshold produces noisy detections that limit final accuracy.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Detection performance tends to degrade when the IoU threshold used for training is increased.

unmatched_b.b_claim_text_normalized: The output of a detector trained with a given IoU threshold is a good distribution for training the next higher quality detector.
